if (typeof module !== 'undefined' && module.exports) {
  module.exports = { lessonQuestionBanks, moduleQuizQuestions };

// ============================================================
// WIRING, added 2026-08-20 by stream E (Maths Extension 1).
//
// `question-bank.js` serves `window[DATA_KEY] || {}` with DATA_KEY =
// 'HSCQuestionBankData'. A top-level `const` in a classic script is NOT a property
// of window, so `lessonQuestionBanks` above was invisible to the runtime: this file
// loaded, parsed, resolved its path, passed `audit:banks` -- and served nothing.
// Every lesson keyed here had an empty Practice phase for exactly that reason.
// See the same block in ../module5/question-bank-data.js for the field-map rationale.
//
// PLACEHOLDER FILTER, and why it is not optional.
// This file's `lessonQuestionBanks` is part real question, part scaffold left by
// whoever stubbed the module: prompts of the form "Question 3 for Lesson 7" with
// options ["A","B","C","D"], and "Sample question 5 for <title>" with options
// ["Option A".."Option D"]. Those carry a valid numeric `answer`, so they are
// ANSWERABLE and every answerability filter passes them straight through to the
// learner. Wiring this file without the filter below does not repair a dark
// Practice phase, it fills it with content-free multiple choice -- a worse
// failure than the empty section, because an empty section reads as missing and a
// lettered stub reads as taught. Measured at the time of writing: of 732 stored
// questions across modules 6-10, 540 were scaffold and 192 were real.
//
// The filter drops a question when its PROMPT is a scaffold template or when EVERY
// option is a bare label. Those two tests selected identical sets on all five files
// (80/80, 96/96, 124/124, 120/120, 120/120); the OR is kept so that a future
// half-edited stub is caught by whichever half still shows.
//
// This wiring therefore RAISES the served count from zero without inventing a
// single question. Where a lesson stored no real question it still serves none,
// and that is the honest state -- authoring is a separate job from wiring.
//
// NOTE: `moduleQuizQuestions` is NOT wired and must not be. Nothing in the
// repository reads that name; the module quizzes hold their questions inline in
// `module-quiz.html`.
// ============================================================
window.HSCQuestionBankData = window.HSCQuestionBankData || {};
(function () {
  var SCAFFOLD_PROMPT = /^\s*(?:Question\s+\d+\s+for\s+Lesson\s+\d+|Sample\s+question\s+\d+\b|Quiz\s+question\s+\d+\b)/i;
  var BARE_OPTION = /^\s*(?:Option\s+[A-D]|[A-D])\s*$/;
  Object.keys(lessonQuestionBanks).forEach(function (lessonId) {
    var questions = (lessonQuestionBanks[lessonId] || []).map(function (q) {
      var options = (q.options || []).map(String);
      var idx = typeof q.answer === 'number' ? q.answer : -1;
      if (idx < 0 || idx >= options.length) idx = -1;
      return {
        id: q.id,
        prompt: q.question || q.prompt || '',
        options: options,
        correctIndex: idx,
        explanation: q.explanation || '',
        topic: q.topic || 'further-applications-of-calculus',
        topics: q.topics || [q.topic || 'further-applications-of-calculus'],
        difficulty: typeof q.difficulty === 'number' ? q.difficulty : 3,
        bloom: q.bloom || 'understand'
      };
    }).filter(function (q) {
      // Answerable: the Format A branch of normaliseBankData returns as-is and does
      // NOT filter, so an unanswerable question here ships visibly broken.
      if (!q.prompt || q.options.length < 2 || q.correctIndex < 0) return false;
      // Not scaffold. See the note above.
      if (SCAFFOLD_PROMPT.test(q.prompt)) return false;
      if (q.options.every(function (o) { return BARE_OPTION.test(o); })) return false;
      return true;
    });
    // An entry with an empty question list is worse than no entry: the runtime
    // renders a bank that exists and is empty. Publish only what can be served,
    // and leave the rest legitimately absent.
    if (!questions.length) return;
    window.HSCQuestionBankData[lessonId] = {
      lessonId: lessonId,
      subsetSize: Math.min(5, questions.length),
      questions: questions
    };
  });
})();
